purpose: Run compiled Magic Wand, Holy Wand, Knife, and Thousand Edge row data, automatic schedules, target selection, and logical projectile hits in pinned UZDoom
notes: All four weapon forms and three targets are controlled fixtures; this room does not claim natural acquisition or source-exact combat timing.
Magic Wand and Holy Wand target the nearest live logical enemy; Knife and Thousand Edge use the player's view yaw projected onto the XY plane.
The runner compares yaw-zero and pitch/FOV-only runs and checks the actual accepted hit records.
